summaries.text: Fairness in Nursing Home Arbitration Act - Provides that a pre-dispute arbitration agreement between a long-term care facility and a resident (or anyone acting on the resident's behalf) shall not be valid or specifically enforceable.

(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)
